card.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
card.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me fix your bike before you ride. I know which bolts matter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the checking. There must be something left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come riding with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without a repair to do? Give me a minute to remember how.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 protects through bolt expertise, A3 seeks remaining necessary checking and A5 falters when only shared riding is wanted.

relationship.evidence: B2 has competently prepared the bike and B4 warmly offers companionship.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes the need for control and A5 exposes how little confidence remains in simple participation.
